identificationModule.briefTitle: Study of ANX005 in Adults With Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (ALS)

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This study is a multi-center, open-label study of intravenous (IV) ANX005 in participants with ALS.

armGroups.label: ANX005
armGroups.description: Participants will receive induction dosing of ANX005 on Days 1 and 5 or 6, followed by maintenance doses of ANX005 every 2 weeks up to Week 22.

primaryOutcomes.measure: Number of Participants Who Experienced Treatment-Emergent Adverse Events

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Maximum Observed Serum Concentration (Cmax) of ANX005
Area Under the ANX005 Serum Concentration-Time Curve
Change from Baseline in Free Complement (C) 1q Serum Concentrations
